formal_statement: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V)) (π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinClause V)) (w h k : ℕ) (U : Submodule (ZMod 2) (MvPolynomial V (ZMod 2))), 1 ≤ h → 1 ≤ k → (∀ C ∈ F, C.card ≤ w) → PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsLinRefutation F π → (∀ f ∈ U, f.totalDegree ≤ k) → (∀ f ∈ U, f ≠ 0 → ¬ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.PCDerivable (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.cnfSystem F) (k * (max (2 * h + w) (4 * h + 1) + 1)) f) → Module.finrank (ZMod 2) U ≤ π.length * (Fintype.card V - (h * (k + 1) + 1) + k).choose k
plain_statement: For a CNF of width w on v variables with a dag-like Res(+) refutation of S lines, and h, k at least 1: a space U of polynomials of degree at most k over F2, none of whose nonzero members is derivable in degree k(max(2h+w, 4h+1)+1) from the CNF's polynomial system, has dimension at most S * C(v - h(k+1) - 1 + k, k). The generic form of L-pcx-033, 034, 038 (Thm 9.1 of the unrefereed arXiv:2609.23015).
title: General criterion: the size of a Res(+) refutation of a CNF bounds the dimension of any separated space of low-degree polynomials
